# 1 Enoch Chapter 45 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**45:1** This is the Second Parable — about those who deny the name of the holy dwelling and the Lord of Spirits.

**45:2** They will not ascend to heaven, nor will they set foot upon the earth. That will be the fate of those sinners who have denied the name of the Lord of Spirits — they are being held in reserve for the day of anguish and tribulation.

**45:3** On that day my Elect One will be seated on the throne of glory, and he will pass judgment on their deeds. Their resting places will be beyond number. The righteous will feel their souls strengthened within them when they see my Elect One, and all those who have called upon my glorious name.

**45:4** On that day I will let my Elect One live among them. I will transform the heavens and make them a source of eternal blessing and light.

**45:5** I will transform the earth as well, making it a blessing, and I will let my chosen ones live there. But sinners and evildoers will never walk upon it.

**45:6** I have given my righteous ones peace and satisfaction, and I have let them stand before me. But for the sinners, judgment is coming — I will wipe them from the face of the earth.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Chapter 45 is a hinge point in the entire Parables. God himself announces the Elect One's enthronement and the renewal of heaven and earth. The promise "I will cause my Elect One to dwell among them" (v. 4) sounds the note of divine dwelling — immanence — that will echo through apocalyptic and NT theology.*
